join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command editor
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !command editor <name>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command editor pan
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add pan FOUND THE (_PARAMETER_CAPS_), HAVE YE?
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command editor pan
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' was last modified by foobar.

handle hortbot foobar/1 modman/2 access=moderator :!command add pan FOUND THE (_PARAMETER_CAPS_), HAVE YE?
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' updated, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command editor pan
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' was last modified by modman.
